question: Should Factory `auto` silently prefer any discovered API key—including `~/.factory/.env`—over the existing browser/session account and stop on non-auth API failures?
rationale: This changes existing Auto routing and potentially the displayed Factory account for users who already have credentials outside CodexBar; tests can prove mechanics but cannot choose the intended upgrade/account-precedence policy.

options.title: Require explicit API selection
options.body: Keep existing Auto web/session behavior and use Factory API credentials only when the user selects `api`, avoiding silent upgrade and account-precedence changes.

options.title: Approve API-first Auto
options.body: Accept discovered-key precedence in Auto and document that network or parsing failures do not fall back to the browser/session account.

options.title: API-first with broader fallback
options.body: Prefer the API key in Auto but fall back to web for transient API failures, trading failure visibility for compatibility and continuity.

recommendation.title: Require explicit API selection
recommendation.body: Keep existing Auto web/session behavior and use Factory API credentials only when the user selects `api`, avoiding silent upgrade and account-precedence changes.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns most recent Factory routing, auth fallback, settings, and Linux provider history and is the strongest available decision owner.
